confidence_notes: Medium overall. Beer, coffee, and meal anchors reflect general knowledge of typical Cebu restaurant prices and are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain because rates vary by district (Cebu City vs. Mactan/Lapu-Lapu) and season. Cocktail and wine were set from the local price relationship to beer because direct knowledge is weak; beer assumes a bottled local lager as the closest analogue to a draft serving. No live listings, menus, or booking pages were consulted, and figures are projected to a July 2026 window from general knowledge. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Holistic judgment rather than a single comparable city: Cebu was compared against mid-sized Visayas and Southeast Asian tourist cities with similar cost structures, such as Iloilo City, with accommodation weighted toward Cebu City and Mactan hotel stock. This is not a sourced price comparison.
